settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subheading: Everything you need to know about our products, shipping, and returns.

settings.question: How long does standard shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 1-2 business days. Standard delivery typically takes 2-5 business days across the continental US. Real-time carrier tracking is emailed immediately upon dispatch.

settings.question: Are all products backed by verifiable manufacturer specifications?
settings.answer: Yes. Every single item in the Leafanoo catalog features verified GTIN/UPC barcodes and manufacturer part numbers (MPNs), ensuring 100% authentic product standards.

settings.question: What is your 30-day return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a hassle-free 30-day return window on all eligible items. If you are not completely satisfied, simply contact support for a prepaid return label and prompt refund.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay via 256-bit SSL encrypted checkout.
